 "data": "flowchart LR
 subgraph S1 [1A. External Predictive Context]
 Meteo[Meteo Forecasting <br/> Light exposure, Wind, Temperature, etc..]
 Spacial[Spacial data and GIS <br/> GPS grid nodes location]
 end

 subgraph S2 [2. GIP Model]
 subgraph S2_1 [2.1 Data Stream]
 Trans[Transformation, <br/> Filtering and <br/> space-time <br/> synchronization data]
 end

 subgraph S2_2 [2.2 Physics and AI - Digital Twin]
 direction TB
 Multi[Multimodal filtered state]
 GNN[GNN / PINN Surrogate Models <br/> Prediction from Meteo and Space-time sync]
 Prediction[Prediction of incomming warnings and fluctuations]
 end

 subgraph S2_3 [2.3 Cognitive LLM Orchestrator]
 direction TB
 LLM[LLM Cognitive Analysis<br/> Decisions and strategy]
 Suggestion[Solution Suggestion, e.g. <br/> reconfiguration, choices BESS]
 Guardrails[Failsafe Guardrails]
 DAE[DAE Physics solver - Modflow <br/> Absolute Physics Truth]
 end

 subgraph S2_4 [2.4 Action]
 Dispatch[Dispatch TSO/DSO <br/> Decission support]
 Microgrid[Microgrid / Agregation <br/> Automated management]
 end
 end

 subgraph S6 [6. Physical grid infrastructure]
 TSO[TSO - Transfer system <br/> SCADA, MAMS / PMU]
 DSO[DSO - Distribution system <br/> local SCADA, RTU]
 Terminal[Terminal grids / Microgrids <br/> Smart Meters, OZE, BESS]
 end

 %% Connections
 Meteo -->|Weather prediction for OZE| Trans
 Spacial -->|Grid Topology| Trans
 Trans --> Multi
 Multi --> GNN
 GNN --> Prediction
 Prediction --> LLM

 LLM --> Suggestion
 Suggestion --> Guardrails

 Guardrails -->|Approved, physically possible action| Dispatch
 Guardrails -->|Approved, physically possible action| Microgrid
 Guardrails -->|Validation against physical limits| DAE
 DAE -->|Safety Confirmation| Guardrails

 Dispatch -->|Dispatcher manual intervention| TSO
 Microgrid -->|Dispatcher manual intervention| DSO
 Microgrid -->|Feedback, physical redirection| DSO
 Dispatch -->|Feedback, physical redirection| TSO

 TSO -->|Raw telemetry| Trans
 DSO -->|Raw telemetry| Trans
 Terminal -->|Raw telemetry| Trans
